# Fundex Global

> Fundex Global (Fundex Global Pty Ltd, Melbourne, Australia; founded 2026) is a strategy and execution partner for founders and growing businesses. Positioning: "Where strategy meets execution."

Fundex Global is not a fund, does not hold an Australian Financial Services Licence, and does not provide financial product advice, make investment recommendations, arrange or deal in investments, or handle client money.

## Pages

- [Services](https://www.fundexglobal.vc/services): strategy & venture design; execution & growth support; business planning & pitch preparation; commercial partnerships & business development
- [About](https://www.fundexglobal.vc/about): company background and founder
- [Contact](https://www.fundexglobal.vc/contact): enquiry form
- [Legal & scope](https://www.fundexglobal.vc/legal): scope of services, website terms, scam warning
- [Privacy](https://www.fundexglobal.vc/privacy): privacy policy and collection notice
